name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Tunic
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Tunic: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My eyes failed me long ago, but I do not miss them. Even in a tribe such as ours - where one's vestments convey station and purpose - the most potent of garb exudes power that simple eyes cannot see. The prized tunic of the Zandalar madcap is no exception, exuding the raw power of chaos and madness that they are able to channel.
The Paragons of Power I need lie in Zul'Gurub; bring me what I seek, and I will reward you with your own legendary tunic... One befitting a weaver of madness.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Welcome back to the Isle, friend... Have you returned triumphantly with the Paragons of Power in tow?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive... You have accomplished today what few thought was possible. Your reverence in the tribe is assured for a lifetime, friend. You have earned the right to don the madcap's tunic - do so with our blessing.
